stage: DP0-A Phase 2 - official provider documentation check

sources_consulted.title: DeepSeek API Docs - Chat Completions API
DeepSeek API Docs - Thinking Mode guide
DeepSeek API Docs - JSON Output guide

summary: Official documentation consulted directly (no third-party sources). Web search was unavailable, so the official pages were fetched directly.

supported_models.statement: Chat Completions model field accepts [deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro]; OpenAI-format base URL https://api.deepseek.com

thinking_mode.statement: thinking object controls the switch; type enabled|disabled; DEFAULT VALUE IS enabled. Thinking effort default is high; deepseek-v4-pro currently supports effort high and max only.
thinking_mode.conclusion: The current production request runs in thinking mode by default (provider-defaulted), because the payload never sends the thinking toggle.

json_output.statement: response_format {"type":"json_object"} guarantees the generated message is valid JSON; the model must ALSO be instructed to produce JSON in the system or user message.
json_output.instruction_present: system prompt: 'Return exactly one JSON object matching required_schema and no markdown'
json_output.caveat: The guarantee applies to a complete generation; content cut off at the token limit (finish_reason=length) is partial and can be invalid JSON.

finish_reason_length.statement: Official docs: 'the message content may be partially cut off if finish_reason="length", which indicates the generation exceeded max_tokens or the conversation exceeded the max context length.'
finish_reason_length.conclusion: finish_reason=length is the documented truncation signal.

token_usage.statement: usage object: completion_tokens, prompt_tokens (= cache_hit + cache_miss), total_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens (reasoning output tokens).

max_output.statement: max_tokens is the maximum number of tokens generated; total input+generated tokens are limited by the model context length (deepseek-v4-pro context 1M; max output maximum 384K per Models & Pricing).
max_output.conclusion: 1800 is far below the model maximum; any length truncation at 1800 is a request-level budget artifact, not a model cap.

timeout_and_retry_guidance.statement: No explicit client-timeout value is mandated in the consulted pages; rate limits and error codes are documented separately (concurrency 500 for deepseek-v4-pro).

sdk_compatibility.statement: The application uses stdlib urllib (no OpenAI/DeepSeek SDK), so SDK-version compatibility does not apply; the transport only needs correct HTTP JSON semantics, which the official OpenAI-format endpoint provides.
